history.summary: Marta meets Lukas, who takes her to the station free of charge. She promises to tell him about her journey tomorrow.
history.cliffhanger: At the station, Marta is about to discover that her ticket is missing.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Guten Morgen! Fahren Sie zum Bahnhof?
scenes.fa: صبح بخیر! به ایستگاه قطار می‌روید؟
scenes.scene: Marta stands beside the taxi and politely asks Lukas a question; medium two shot.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks and raises one hand politely; Lukas listens and nods.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ja, natürlich. Steigen Sie bitte ein.
scenes.scene: Lukas stands by the open passenger door and welcomes Marta; the seat is visible.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks and opens the passenger door wider, offering his hand.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Marta beside the taxi, holding her small coin purse.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, opens her purse and looks up with a questioning expression.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Lukas outside the teal taxi, facing Marta just off camera.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks kindly and makes one small explanatory gesture with his open hand.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Oh, ich habe nur fünf Euro dabei.
scenes.fa: اوه، من فقط پنج یورو همراهم دارم.
scenes.scene: Marta looks worried into her nearly empty purse beside the open taxi door.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, looks down at the coins and then looks back up at Lukas.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Kein Problem. Heute fahren Sie kostenlos.
scenes.scene: Both characters beside the open teal taxi, Lukas gently holding out his hand to help Marta.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks with a warm smile, takes Marta's hand gently and nods reassuringly.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Wirklich? Das ist sehr freundlich von Ihnen.
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Marta, her worried expression turning into a relieved smile.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks in delighted surprise, smiles and briefly lifts her free hand to her chest.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ich helfe Ihnen mit der Tasche.
scenes.scene: Lukas carefully takes Marta's leather handbag while she stands by the open passenger door.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks, gently lifts the handbag and moves it towards the back seat.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Vielen Dank. Mein Zug fährt um zwölf Uhr.
scenes.fa: خیلی ممنون. قطار من ساعت دوازده حرکت می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Marta is seated comfortably in the rear of the taxi, looking towards Lukas at the driver's door.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, settles into the seat and looks towards the driver with a grateful smile.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Keine Sorge. Wir kommen rechtzeitig an.
scenes.scene: Interior taxi two shot with Lukas in the driver seat and Marta in the rear seat, village street outside.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks reassuringly, looks ahead and gently turns the steering wheel as the street moves outside.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Da vorne ist schon der Bahnhof.
scenes.scene: Taxi interior looking past Lukas towards the grand train station ahead; Marta visible in the back seat.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks and briefly points towards the station ahead, while the taxi slows smoothly.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Danke! Wie kann ich mich bedanken?
scenes.fa: ممنون! چطور می‌توانم از شما تشکر کنم؟
scenes.scene: At the station curb, Marta looks out through the open rear window towards Lukas standing outside.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks gratefully through the open window and makes a small warm gesture.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Erzählen Sie mir morgen von Ihrer Reise.
scenes.fa: فردا از سفرتان برایم تعریف کنید.
scenes.scene: Lukas beside the taxi and Marta at the open window, both waving goodbye at the station.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks with a friendly smile, waves gently; Marta returns the wave.
